open_text_result: No reusable, non-OCR Greek transcription matching Körte’s collected fragments was found. The Perseus record establishes exact author (Metrodorus of Lampsacus), edition and Greek language but does not itself provide a licensed text file. No provider OCR was used.
open_text_license: No open-text licence for a complete transcription of the edition was verified.
scan_result: Exact historical-edition scan found: Internet Archive/Open Content Alliance item metrodoriepicure00metruoft. The printed p.537 bears the running title ‘Metrodori Epicurei fragmenta etc.’ and Greek source material; printed p.565 bears the same running title and the end of the fragment section immediately before the Appendix. Greek was visually verified at both boundaries. Canon’s non-contiguous pagination 537–552 and 554–565 is preserved; p.553 is not inferred into scope.
scan_rights: The 1890 edition is public domain, but the Internet Archive metadata gives no explicit image-reuse/public-redistribution licence. Public access and the Open Content Alliance label are not treated as a licence for the public HF corpus.
next_action: Seek explicit compatible reuse terms for this digitisation or an equivalently licensed scan. If cleared, remotely transfer only printed pp.537–552 and 554–565 (leaves 14–29 and 31–42), explicitly excluding p.553, then perform project-owned OCR and retain exact provenance.
notes: The work is Metrodorus of Lampsacus, Epicurean, and must not be merged with Metrodorus of Chios or Scepsis. Endpoint samples showed actual Greek rather than relying on IA OCR; all temporary metadata/images were deleted. No provider OCR, commit, or push occurred.
